observation.visible_scene: Indoor shot against a white textured wall with a dark object at the top right. A woman in a white shirt is seated at a table. On the left stands a white bottle labeled 'ALCOHOL 96%'. In the center is a clear glass holding a yellowish liquid with a slanted pencil-like stick inside, steadied by her left hand. In her right hand she holds a plastic bottle with a red flip-top cap and a red label, containing a yellowish liquid.
visible_changes: At the start the red-capped bottle is upright and motion-blurred near her shoulder while her left hand is raised; over the first few frames the bottle is lowered and tilted toward the glass and the red flip cap is seen open.
Her left hand moves down and rests around the glass, holding it steady.
From roughly the middle of the clip a thin continuous stream of liquid pours from the bottle's mouth into the glass and persists to the last frame, with the bottle held at a fixed tilt.
The alcohol bottle, the glass, and the stick remain in essentially the same positions; the background and framing stay constant, indicating a static camera rather than camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the pouring began before the first frame or continues after the last.
The actual contents/brand of the red-capped bottle and the purpose of pouring it into the glass.
What the woman does after this segment.
uncertain_details: The exact frame at which the liquid stream first becomes visible.
Whether the liquid level in the glass rises noticeably during the pour.
Whether the slanted object in the glass is a pencil or another stick.
The label text on the red bottle (partially obscured).
